[SWS_CRYPT_01807]
⌈
The SetKey interface of the AuthCipherCtx shall
check the allowed-usage flags of the key parameter provided.
• SetKey shall return a SecurityErrorDomain::kUsageViolation error, if
kAllowDataEncryption is not set and the transformation direction is Cryp-
toTransform::kEncrypt.
• SetKey shall return a SecurityErrorDomain::kUsageViolation error, if
kAllowDataDecryption is not set and the transformation direction is Cryp-
toTransform::kDecrypt.
⌋
